spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), INTERVAL 15 MINUTE) AS ts, if(countIf(JSONExtractString(body,'verdict')='reject') >= 5, 100.0 * countIf(JSONExtractString(body,'verdict')='reject') / count(), 0) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['k8s.namespace.name'] = 'tappa' AND resources_string['k8s.container.name'] = 'tappa' AND JSONExtractString(body, 'msg') = 'tap.decision' GROUP BY ts

annotations.description: More than 10% of taps rejected in 15 min (at least 5). A plaque lost/retired/unassigned, SUN verification failing, or an account trying. See deploy/README.md M8-03 rule 1.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT ts, toFloat64(sum(c) > 20 OR max(c) > 10) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), INTERVAL 60 MINUTE) AS ts, JSONExtractString(body,'matched_sid') AS sid, count() AS c FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['k8s.namespace.name'] = 'tappa' AND resources_string['k8s.container.name'] = 'tappa' AND JSONExtractString(body, 'msg') = 'tap.decision' AND JSONExtractString(body,'verdict')='flag' GROUP BY ts, sid) GROUP BY ts

annotations.description: More than 20 flagged taps in 60 min, or more than 10 for one rule. Evidence is short (often a venue's address list or GPS). See M8-03 rule 2.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, toFloat64(count()) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['k8s.namespace.name'] = 'tappa' AND resources_string['k8s.container.name'] = 'tappa' AND JSONExtractString(body, 'msg') = 'tap.security_alert' GROUP BY ts

annotations.description: A tap.security_alert line: a deactivated account tapped, or the second cause in M8-03 rule 3. matched_sid says which. Look at the line in SigNoz.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS ts, toFloat64(count()) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['k8s.namespace.name'] = 'tappa' AND resources_string['k8s.container.name'] = 'tappa' AND JSONExtractString(body, 'msg') = 'tap.decision' AND JSONExtractInt(body,'ctr_gap') > 10 GROUP BY ts

annotations.description: A plaque was read more often than the server saw (ctr_gap > 10; > 50 is urgent). The only visible trace of URL harvesting. See M8-03 rule 4.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS ts, toFloat64(count()) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['k8s.namespace.name'] = 'tappa' AND resources_string['k8s.container.name'] = 'tappa' AND JSONExtractString(body, 'msg') = 'http.request' AND JSONExtractString(body,'level') = 'ERROR' GROUP BY ts

annotations.description: More than 5 HTTP 5xx answers in 5 min. The server is broken; a panic is turned into a 500 and shows here. See M8-03 rule 5.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, toFloat64(count()) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['k8s.namespace.name'] = 'tappa' AND resources_string['k8s.container.name'] = 'tappa' AND JSONExtractString(body, 'msg') = 'readiness.lost' GROUP BY ts

annotations.description: The database is not answering; /readyz returns 503 and the pod leaves rotation. Closes with readiness.regained. See M8-03 rule 6.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, toFloat64(count()) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['k8s.namespace.name'] = 'tappa' AND resources_string['k8s.container.name'] = 'tappa' AND JSONExtractString(body,'operator_surface') = 'unavailable' GROUP BY ts

annotations.description: The pod started without the operator surface (OP-7 settings missing or refused). ops.taptime.mt answers 503. See M8-03 rule 7.
